basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old based in Toronto, Canada. I recently joined Reddit to explore communities related to my interests. I'm a huge fan of golf and can't get enough of playing Ultimate Golf online. I work as a graphic designer, which allows me to have a flexible schedule, so I usually browse Reddit during late evenings. I enjoy watching 'Canada's Drag Race' and I'm curious about diverse cultures, which is why I sometimes explore threads like 'realasians'. I'm single and often find myself engaging in discussions about lifestyle improvements.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for over three years. My knowledge of golf is mostly self-taught through playing and watching online tutorials. I also have a casual interest in drag culture that I've been exploring through TV shows and online communities.
